product_ref: required; your own id for the line; rows sharing one are variants of it
product_name: required; the line, as a shopper would see it
sku: required; unique per row; what everybody outside your systems says
variant_name: required; what distinguishes this row from its siblings
is_base: required; true on exactly one row per product reference
category: required; one of the codes on the Categories sheet
claims: optional; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
compliance.certificate_ref: optional; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers, home.floorcare.vacuums, and 5 more only
compliance.min_age: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; applies to home.cookware.knives only; the number only, in years - never '65 years'
compliance.sale_permitted: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; true or false
energy.class: optional; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers, home.floorcare.vacuums, and 5 more only
identifiers.gtin: required by CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B; 14 digits, kept as text - leading zeros are significant
specs.coverage_m2: optional; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers only; the number only, in m² - never '65 m²'
specs.filter_type: optional; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers only
specs.noise_db: optional; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers, home.floorcare.vacuums, and 5 more only; the number only, in dB - never '65 dB'
specs.plug_type: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers, home.floorcare.vacuums, and 5 more only
specs.power_w: required by CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B, CH-PRINT, CH-SHELF; applies to home.air-treatment.fans, home.air-treatment.humidifiers, home.air-treatment.purifiers, home.floorcare.vacuums, and 5 more only; the number only, in W - never '65 W'
textile.care_code: optional; applies to home.textiles.bedding, home.textiles.towels only
textile.fibre_composition: optional; order is part of the value; do not sort; applies to home.textiles.bedding, home.textiles.towels only; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
image.HERO: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.IN_SITU: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.DETAIL: optional; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
